`reference.npz` was generated using the pre-refactor window extraction, Ledoit-Wolf geometry, TV denoising, and consecutive-statistic routines. It contains a fixed two-channel synthetic series and expected numerical outputs. Context length is 32, stride 1, TV weight 8, 200 iterations, tolerance 1e-5, and edge trimming is enabled. The deterministic summary adapter pools mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum across channels. This fixture tests refactoring parity, not scientific correctness or pretrained-model equivalence.
